newsitem.title: GERMANY: WestLB says ups Dresdner EPS forecasts.
newsitem.headline: WestLB says ups Dresdner EPS forecasts.

text.p: WestLB Research said on Tuesday it raised its earnings per share forecasts for Dresdner Bank AG for 1997 and 1998 after the German bank announced a 23 percent rise in first-half operating profit.
WestLB analyst Stefan Ermisch said he raised the 1997 estimate to 3.60 marks ($1.96) from 3.30 marks and the 1998 forecast to 3.90 marks from 3.60 marks.
Both forecasts took into account Dresdner's plans to increase its nominal capital by 120 million marks, Ermisch said.
He had rated Dresdner as an "outperformer" since November.
"We are strongly positive for the second half of this year," Ermisch said. "We expect to see Dresdner as a significant outperformer by the end of the year."
Ermisch said both Dresdner and Deutsche Bank AG were following sensible strategies, particularly in investment banking.
He also welcomed Dresdner's announcement of plans to increase its cooperation with insurer Allianz AG, which he said made sense with closer European integration approaching.
